data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: bypass-mechanism stories (DSO_*_BYPASS / --force-* / --override-* / escape-hatch patterns) introduced by epic specs lack a paired governance story (audit log + justification variable + session-close count report). Proposed fix: add a bypass-keyword scanner to preplanning SKILL.md pre-finalization checklist that scans brainstorm spec text for bypass-pattern matches and blocks story finalization unless a paired governance story is added and linked via depends_on. Classification: MODERATE — single SKILL.md edit. The d076 rescue already implemented the audit log in check-session-merge-only.sh; this bug only requires preplanning to enforce the paired-story pattern at planning time. Not addressed in this P2 pass (focused on highest-value code + 3-bug brainstorm group); leaving OPEN for follow-up.
